purpose: Represent multiple logical external semantic inputs such as observation, memory, objective and constraints while explicitly preserving the current single-input graph runtime boundary.

scope.data_plane: CompiledGraph.run still accepts one WasmTensor and seeds only slot 0

execution.compiler_policy: current CompiledGraph compiler begins with only slot 0 filled
execution.runtime_policy: current CompiledGraph.run places the supplied WasmTensor only into slot 0

semantics.deferred_port_meaning: declared semantic ingress with no executable graph input backing yet

port.role: agent-input-port.v1 canonical role or x- extension role
port.required: whether current runtime coverage must include this port for the manifest to report complete coverage

addRuntimeBackedPort.rule: runtime_slot must be 0 and only one logical port may claim slot-0 backing

addDeferredPort.rule: declares semantic intent only and never claims executable graph backing

manifestFingerprint.identity: order-independent FNV-1a correlation over the declared logical port set

semanticIngressManifestStatus.workspace_read: compares the manifest's runtime-backed port against current slot-0 semantic metadata
semanticIngressManifestStatus.runtime_coverage_complete: true only when every required manifest port has current real runtime backing

status.runtime_backing_current: slot-0 workspace semantic metadata exactly matches the runtime-backed declaration
status.runtime_backing_drifted: slot-0 workspace semantic metadata differs from the declaration
status.runtime_input_unbound: slot-0 semantic input metadata is currently unbound
status.deferred_no_runtime_backing: logical ingress is declared but the graph runtime has no backing surface for it yet

identity.manifest_fingerprint: stable set identity for logical ingress declarations
identity.semantic_graph_identity_effect: none until a future explicit binding contract exists

invariants: the manifest never claims slot 1 or later is an executable external graph input
the manifest never alters CompiledGraph plan bytes
the manifest never alters Burn programIdentity
the manifest never mutates AgentWorkspace, AgentGraphBuilder or LayerRegistry
a required deferred port makes runtime_coverage_complete false
runtime coverage describes backing availability, not permission to execute
existing slot-0 input contract and semantic input port remain canonical for the real graph input
